behavior: State selection populates District options from state-districts.js.
Enrollment dates are autofilled with the current Asia/Kolkata date when empty.
Member child count/details are shown or hidden by the child toggle.
Account, cadet, member and program photo/signature previews use object URLs.
Password visibility is toggled by adjacent password buttons.
Registration type selection hides the other forms and displays the selected form.
Each detailed form has a Back control that returns to the type selector.
Member submission validates, then shows the simulated payment screen; Back returns to the member form; proceeding records the demo registration without a real charge.
Cadet, volunteer and intern submissions show success banners after API confirmation.
Account creation submits to /api/auth/register and navigates into the authenticated member/cadet flow.

disclaimers: Aadhaar/PAN/income inputs are not collected; corresponding fields/files are filtered or omitted by the running app.
Bank account and IFSC fields exist in Member markup but are excluded from safeEntries payload filtering.
Section titles/numbers and visible source text are captured verbatim, including existing oddities.
